payhere.title: PayHere Online Payment
payhere.description: Pay securely with Visa, MasterCard, Genie, FriMi or eZ Cash.

koko.title: Koko (Buy Now Pay Later)
koko.description: Pay in 3 interest-free installments using Debit / Credit card.

payzy.title: Payzy (Buy Now Pay Later)
payzy.description: Pay in up to 4 interest-free installments with Payzy.

bank.title: Direct Bank Transfer / Deposit
bank.description: Transfer directly into our Commercial Bank or Sampath Bank account and WhatsApp the slip.
bank.instructions: * Please transfer the total amount and send the deposit receipt / screenshot to our WhatsApp (+94 75 669 3358) with your Order ID after placing the order.

cod.title: Cash on Delivery (COD)
cod.description: Pay cash to the courier delivery rider when your package arrives at your doorstep.
